mapper.select: SELECT FROM platform_event WHERE status='PENDING' AND tenant_id=#{tenant} AND available_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND ORDER BY available_at,event_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM platform_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event_id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND available_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_event SET status='DELIVERED' WHERE event_id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'

UPDATE platform_event SET attempts=attempts+IF(#{transient},0,1),transient_attempts=transient_attempts+IF(#{transient},1,0),status=IF(attempts>=#{max} OR transient_attempts>=#{transientMax},'ISOLATED','PENDING'),last_error=#{error},failure_class=#{failureClass},first_failed_at=COALESCE(first_failed_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)),last_failed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),available_at=TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND,1000*#{delayMillis},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE event_id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM platform_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event_id=#{id}
SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM platform_event WHERE status='PENDING' AND tenant_id>#{after} AND available_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND ORDER BY tenant_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tenant_id FROM platform_event WHERE status='PENDING' AND available_at>TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND,-1000*#{windowMillis},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND available_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND attempts=0 AND transient_attempts=0 AND GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY MIN(available_at),tenant_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT event_id,event_type,aggregate_id,status,attempts,available_at,last_error,transient_attempts,failure_class,first_failed_at,last_failed_at,skip_reason,manual_retries FROM platform_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event_id>#{after} ORDER BY event_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_event SET status='PENDING',attempts=0,transient_attempts=0,manual_retries=manual_retries+1,available_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event_id=#{id} AND status IN ('ISOLATED','SKIPPED')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM platform_event WHERE status='ISOLATED' AND tenant_id=#{tenant} AND failure_class=#{failureClass} AND event_id>#{after} ORDER BY event_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM platform_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM platform_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_event SET status='SKIPPED',skip_reason='OPERATOR_SKIPPED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event_id=#{id} AND status='ISOLATED'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(status='PENDING' AND ),0) pending, COALESCE(SUM(status='PENDING' AND AND available_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)),0) due, COALESCE(SUM(status='PENDING' AND AND (attempts>0 OR transient_attempts>0)),0) retrying, COALESCE(SUM(status='ISOLATED'),0) isolated, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,MIN(IF(status='PENDING' AND AND available_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),available_at,NULL)),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) oldest_due_age_seconds, COALESCE(SUM(status='PENDING' AND NOT ),0) unrouted, (SELECT MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,e.created_at,i.processed_at))DIV 1000 FROM (SELECT event_id,processed_at FROM platform_inbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} ORDER BY processed_at DESC LIMIT 100) i JOIN platform_event e ON e.event_id=i.event_id)NULL recent_max_latency_millis, COALESCE(SUM(status='PENDING' AND AND transient_attempts>0),0) transient_retrying FROM platform_event WHERE status IN ('PENDING','ISOLATED') AND tenant_id=#{tenant}
